description: This file defines testing utilities for the zap logging library, including a custom logger and writer that integrate with Go's testing.TB interface.

classes.name: LoggerOption
classes.description: Interface for configuring the logger options.

classes.name: loggerOptions
classes.description: Struct holding configuration options for the logger.

classes.name: TestingWriter
classes.description: Struct implementing a WriteSyncer that writes to testing.TB.

methods.name: Level
methods.description: Sets the logging level for the test logger.

methods.name: WrapOptions
methods.description: Adds zap.Options to the logger configuration.

methods.name: NewLogger
methods.description: Creates a new zap.Logger that logs to testing.TB.

methods.name: NewTestingWriter
methods.description: Creates a TestingWriter that writes to testing.TB.

methods.name: WithMarkFailed
methods.description: Returns a copy of TestingWriter with markFailed set.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes bytes to testing.TB, stripping trailing newline.
